findings.summary: The migrate loop's `*)` (failure) case dropped `failed=$((failed + 1))`, which the pre-diff code had in this exact branch. Any migrate failure (bad status, or empty status from the new network-failure fallback `|| status=""`) is logged but no longer counted: the summary line under-reports failures and `[[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]] || exit 1` never fires for migrate failures, so the script exits 0 even when repos silently fail to mirror. This defeats the brief's explicit goal of reliable status-code branching across the migration loop.

findings.summary: `gh_api()` has no `--max-time`/timeout bound at all, while both `gitea_api()` branches got one (60s/1800s). The brief asks to 'bound how long any single request can run' without scoping that to Gitea calls only; GitHub enumeration calls can still hang indefinitely.
